name: Research Science Institute (RSI)
host: MIT / Center for Excellence in Education
description: The gold standard of summer STEM research programs. Students conduct original research under MIT faculty mentors and present at a symposium.

name: MITES (MIT Introduction to Technology, Engineering, and Science)
description: Rigorous STEM coursework for rising seniors from underrepresented backgrounds. Strong pipeline to MIT admissions.

name: Stanford Institutes of Medicine Summer Research (SIMR)
description: Students work in Stanford medical research labs alongside faculty. Top pre-med credential.

name: Garcia Center Summer Scholars
description: NSF-funded research in polymer science and nanoscience. Many alumni publish papers.

name: TASP (Telluride Association Summer Program)
description: Intellectual seminar in humanities/social sciences. One of the most prestigious summer programs in the country.

name: COSMOS (California State Summer School for Mathematics and Science)
location: UC Davis / UC San Diego / UC Santa Cruz / UC Irvine
description: California's premier residential STEM program across four UC campuses.

name: Clark Scholars Program
description: Fully funded research mentorship. 12 scholars selected nationally. $750 stipend included.

name: SSP (Summer Science Program)
host: New Mexico Tech / CU Boulder / Purdue
description: Students determine the orbit of an asteroid or investigate biochemistry. Team-based original research.

name: MOSTEC (MIT Online Science, Technology, and Engineering Community)
description: Year-long online STEM community for rising seniors. Strong MIT admissions pipeline.

name: Girls Who Code Summer Immersion Program
description: Intro to CS for girls and non-binary students. Builds portfolio projects and community.

name: LaunchX
description: Students launch real companies during the program. Not a simulation — real products, real customers.

name: Bank of America Student Leaders
description: Paid internship at a local nonprofit + a leadership summit in DC. Strong civic engagement signal.

name: Simons Summer Research Program
description: Faculty-mentored research in science, math, or engineering. Many students publish or present.

name: YYGS (Yale Young Global Scholars)
description: Yale-run interdisciplinary program. Good but not top-tier in admissions signaling — the experience is the value.

name: SPARC (Summer Program on Applied Rationality and Cognition)
description: Intensive program in applied mathematics, probabilistic thinking, and effective reasoning.

name: Wharton Pre-Baccalaureate Program
description: Intro to business at the world's most famous business school. Finance, leadership, and analytics.

name: Governor's Schools
host: State governments (VA, NC, NJ, PA, TN, etc.)
description: State-sponsored residential programs for top students. Free, competitive, and regionally prestigious.

name: PROMYS (Program in Mathematics for Young Scientists)
description: Intensive number theory and proof-based math for students who love mathematical exploration.

name: HCSSiM (Hampshire College Summer Studies in Mathematics)
description: Proof-based mathematics with emphasis on collaboration. Alumni have won Fields Medals.

name: Interlochen Arts Camp
description: Premier arts camp for music, visual arts, theatre, dance, creative writing, and film.

name: Ross Mathematics Program
description: Intensive number theory program emphasizing exploration and proof-writing. One of the three elite math summer programs alongside PROMYS and Mathcamp. Many alumni become research mathematicians.

name: Canada/USA Mathcamp
description: Summer program for mathematically talented students ages 13-18. Flexible curriculum lets students choose from advanced topics. Strong community of alumni at top math/CS programs.

name: SUMaC (Stanford University Mathematics Camp)
description: Pure mathematics program exploring abstract algebra and number theory. Hosted at Stanford with access to Stanford math faculty. Strong signal for math-focused T20 applications.

name: SAMS (Summer Academy for Math and Science)
description: Free STEM enrichment for rising seniors from underrepresented backgrounds. Coursework in math, CS, and science with CMU faculty. Strong pipeline to CMU admissions.

name: SIP (Science Internship Program)
description: Students work on original research projects in UCSC labs alongside graduate students and faculty. Many participants publish or present at conferences.

name: NIH Summer Internship Program (SIP)
description: Paid research internship at the world's premier biomedical research institution. Students work in NIH labs alongside world-class researchers. Exceptional credential for pre-med and biology applicants.
